title: The Night Chernobyl Exploded
description: 26 April 1986: a safety test at Reactor 4 goes wrong.

scenes.narration: At 1:23 in the morning, a safety test goes terribly wrong.
scenes.image_prompt: Chernobyl nuclear power plant at night 1986, glowing light rising from the reactor building

scenes.narration: It's April 26th, 1986. Reactor number four at the Chernobyl power plant in Soviet Ukraine.
scenes.image_prompt: Chernobyl power plant buildings and chimney at night, 1980s Soviet industrial

scenes.narration: Operators are running a test at low power. The reactor is unstable.
scenes.image_prompt: Soviet control room with operators at panels of dials and switches, tense, 1986

scenes.narration: In seconds, power surges. Steam explodes and blows the massive lid off the reactor.
scenes.image_prompt: explosion inside a reactor hall, debris and steam blasting upward, dramatic lighting

scenes.narration: Firefighters rush in without knowing how much radiation they face.
scenes.image_prompt: Soviet firefighters on a burning rooftop at night spraying water, smoke

scenes.narration: The nearby city of Pripyat isn't evacuated until the next afternoon.
scenes.image_prompt: long line of buses evacuating residents from a Soviet apartment town, 1986

scenes.narration: Around three hundred and fifty thousand people were eventually moved away.
scenes.image_prompt: empty abandoned Soviet town square with apartment blocks

scenes.narration: Today, forest and wildlife are slowly taking the zone back. Would you visit? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: abandoned Pripyat Ferris wheel surrounded by trees, autumn
